$comment: Played after the Hearth is lit, before the credits.
speaker: Elder Ina

one.text: Light pours up the stairs. Somewhere far above, someone in Cinder Cove shouts. Then the first wisp lifts out of the fire, then three, then a hundred.

two.text: Well. I came down all those stairs to tell you to be careful, and you've gone and fixed it. Look at them.

three.text: Every lamp-stone in your crate is lit, {player}. Every stone in every lamp from here to Gull Isle will be by morning. The islands owe you a warm night.

four.text: Now, come up. Bram's lit the forge, Wren's counting wisps, and Dorran is pretending he isn't crying.
